latex.caption: Within-RWM-shot timing: \texttt{rwm-brf} trains only on Hanson RWM shots, so no stable discharge supplies negatives; it forecasts when an RWM comes in a shot that has one, unlike Piccione's 90 stable shots among 134, likely explaining the forest's phase ranking. No skill beyond phase is established by phase-controlled AUROC. Reference split (seed 0): 33 shots, 30 target shots, 48 $n=1$ onsets, 480 positive versus 5,255 assumed-negative 10 ms slices; $5\times3$ nested shot-grouped CV. Positives: 100 ms before listed onsets. Primary assumed negatives end at the last $n=1$ onset; broad adds post-onset and $n=2$-only time, with unchanged exclusions. F1/TPR/FPR use the fold's ROC cutoff nearest (0 FPR, 1 TPR), chosen on inner-OOF primary Hanson slices. Brackets: exploratory 95\% shot-bootstrap intervals at fixed predictions, unadjusted for multiplicity. Within-shot means weight two-class shots equally; elapsed time's 0.931 is an artefact of the primary mask's cutoff at the last onset. Phase-controlled AUROC compares pairs within campaign and 200 ms elapsed-time bins; all paired forest-minus-scalar intervals include zero (repository supplement). The omitted RWM screen is constant zero on primary slices (AUROC 0.500). Legacy uses different inputs and validation.

split_summary.caption: Forest scores and forest-minus-elapsed-time differences. Ranges are point estimates across seeds 0--4, not confidence intervals. Brackets: exploratory 95\% shot-bootstrap intervals, unadjusted for multiplicity, at fixed predictions; individual scores use percentile intervals, paired differences use basic intervals. High-$\beta$: $\beta_N\geq0.8$ shot p95; above-proxy: $\beta_N/l_i>4$. Holdout retains four records across three dates; broad paired intervals are available for seed 0 and holdout only. The primary seed-3 lower bound rounds to $-0.000$; its unrounded value is negative.

within_shot.caption: Within-shot AUROC means on the reference split; each of 30 two-class Hanson shots receives equal weight. Within-shot model means are point estimates; differences have 95\% basic paired shot-bootstrap intervals (1,000 replicates, seed 0), unadjusted for multiplicity. Within shot, the forest is 0.02--0.07 below $\beta_N$ and $\beta_N/l_i$ on both masks (one of four unadjusted intervals excludes zero). Elapsed time's 0.931 is an artefact of the primary mask's cutoff at the last onset. Phase control uses primary positive-negative pairs within campaign and 200 ms elapsed-time bins, weighted by pair counts. Individual phase intervals are percentile; all three basic paired forest-minus-scalar phase intervals include zero. One-class cells are omitted; phase resampling is stratified by campaign.

campaign_pairs.caption: Forest minus elapsed time by campaign. Brackets: exploratory 95\% basic paired shot-bootstrap intervals (1,000 resamples), conditional on fixed fitted predictions, unadjusted for multiplicity. High-$\beta$: $\beta_N\geq0.8$ shot p95; above-proxy: $\beta_N/l_i>4$. All five 2014 point differences are negative in both conditional strata; all five 2018 split-seed intervals include zero. The included 2018 run-record holdout intervals exclude zero: primary $-0.049$ {\scriptsize $[-0.073, -0.013]$}; high-$\beta$ $-0.070$ {\scriptsize $[-0.117, -0.010]$}.

alarms.caption: Forest alarms across all five splits and the run-record holdout. D/E/M: Detected/Early/Missed among 30 target shots. The first considered alarm decides the primary shot category; any-warning precedence is a sensitivity. Per-onset counts retain all alarms. Brackets: 95\% percentile shot-bootstrap intervals, including detection-minus-reference, conditional on fixed fitted predictions and unadjusted for multiplicity. Between-model differences elsewhere use basic paired intervals. No improvement over the approximate rate-matched random reference was established: all five difference intervals include zero; equivalence is not established. Warning medians condition on detected onsets. All four rules were compared on the reference split only; their alarm results were not replayed over seeds 1--4.

onset_actual.caption: Offline EFIT inputs held at the actual listed onset (last sample age $\leq50$ ms): 5 snapshots below $\beta_N/l_i=4$; 4 missing EFIT snapshots. Missing inputs retain their own category. Elapsed time starts at the first $|I_p|\geq0.5$ MA crossing. High-$\beta$ slices are counted in the 100 ms pre-onset forecast window. The pre-onset-window snapshot is distinct from the actual onset; no post-onset extent is inferred.
